title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (Early show) on 1969-09-27

ai_review.summary: Decent‑to‑good sound for a 1969 audience tape that captures a historic moment in the Dead’s early years.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience source from ’69 that, despite its age, offers surprisingly listenable sound quality according to most reviewers. While no specific musical highlights are mentioned, listeners appreciate its historical value and the fact it survived over three decades.

ai_rating.rationale: Two reviewers praise the audio and historic significance (4‑5 stars) while one rates it low; limited performance details keep the overall rating around average‑to‑good.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clearer than many other '69 audience tapes, but still reflects tape‑age limitations; listeners note it is surprisingly listenable for its era.
